$comment: Layer 4, production. Anthem CA settings. Credentials are env-var NAMES only. The producer/agency values are env-var NAMES too: they identify a real licensed producer and a real agency code (which doubles as that agency's encrypted TIN), so they live in .env and never in this file. Get them from the Benefits runbook. See docs/poc/sanitization.md.
$comment_transactionTimeoutMs: This process is a twelve-step Salesforce wizard against a production portal: group setup, portfolios, a census download/upload round-trip, plan selection, quote DOCUMENT GENERATION (30-45s on its own) and a seven-screen employer application. The 120s platform default expires somewhere around the census and reports it as a precondition failure on whatever step was unlucky - which reads like a broken locator and is not. 15 minutes is sized to the real process, not padded.

automation.$comment_mfaTimeoutMs: Measured Anthem delivery on 2026-09-02, across four consecutive requests: ~132s, then >180s, then >300s. Every code DID arrive; the latency escalates when codes are requested repeatedly, which looks like carrier throttling. A too-tight timeout throws away a code that is already in flight and then asks for another, making the throttling worse. 10 minutes is generous on purpose: a session is established once and reused, so this wait is paid once per session, not per transaction.
automation.$comment_mfaResend: Measured 2026-09-02: a code arrived 26s after it was requested. Earlier readings of 132s-600s were an artefact of a reader that could not refresh its view, not of slow delivery. 120s is therefore generous, and it stays well inside the ~291s expiry the portal shows, so a resend always gets a genuinely fresh code.
automation.$comment_typeOfBusiness: STOPGAP. Group-specific data that the shared payload has no field for - see open-questions.md. Correct for the synthetic PoC group only.
automation.$comment_memberEnrollmentType: The wizard step after Signature Format. Verified 2026-09-03: the Application record picklist offers exactly Online Census Tool, Ease, Real-Time, Simple Census, API. Online Census Tool is the only value consistent with the Attestation screen, which declares Online Census Enrollment (OCE).
automation.$comment_allowSubmit: Leave false. The PoC runs against the production portal; true would sign and file a real application.
